plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
runtime: node 22, express, ws, PostgreSQL through openvibe-sdk/db (DATABASE_URL via PgBouncer, DATABASE_DIRECT_URL for migrations/; embedded PGlite outside production), Valkey for the per-actor limits (VALKEY_URL); better-sqlite3 gone (plan T3)
domain: openvibe.chat (Chat's own site: global chat, messages, rooms, settings; the service manifest records it live since 2026-09-24) and openvibe.live (/ws/chat, /api/chat/, /api/dm/, /api/tts/, /api/sounds via an nginx include in openvibe.live's vhost)
eventsConsumed: live.release.deployed, network.module.updated, network.user.token_valid_after, vip.membership.changed, network.block.changed, network.subject.merged, network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted at POST /internal/events (signature v2, openvibe-sdk inbox); subscriptions created at boot when missing (CHAT_EVENTS_SECRET and the Network grant chat events.subscription.manage openvibe.events)
liveAuthorityFlag: CHAT_AUTHORITY=chat is set in production live.env since the cutover (2026-09-23 02:03 UTC); Live's chat tables are a read mirror Chat keeps current
vip: Member badges from OpenVibe.VIP (server/vip/badges.js: entitlements/check with product chat, cached 60 s, never blocks sending, fails closed; vip.membership.changed drops the cache). Needs the Network grant chat vip.entitlement.check openvibe.vip
preferences: Chat preferences in the Network user module chat.preferences, plus chat.tts_defaults, chat.dm_settings and chat.presence_prefs (server/prefs/: /api/chat/preferences and siblings with Chat's service token, cached 60 s, If-Match on every write; scripts/migrate-chat-preferences.js moves the choices in Live's user_preferences). Needs the grants chat network.modules.read/write
calls: Live's call server, call routes and stream hooks ported to server/calls/ with a calls lifecycle table (WS-I task 1). Off unless CHAT_CALLS=1; the switch is CHAT_CALLS=1, Live CALLS_AUTHORITY=chat and the nginx include deploy/nginx/calls/openvibe.live-calls.locations.conf (docs/calls-cutover.md)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy chat`: /opt/openvibe.chat, unit openvibe-chat, 127.0.0.1:4400 (loopback); public through the openvibe.chat vhost and openvibe.live's nginx include for the chat paths; EVENTS_URL set (chat.message.created reaches OpenVibe.Events); restore drill passed 2026-09-23
features: Live's global, stream and channel chat (authority since 2026-09-23, Live keeps a read mirror)
DMs and group DMs, participants only
rooms: public and private, roles, invitations, slow mode, unread counts
moderation: bans, timeouts, purges, filters, slow, sub-only and member-only modes, audited log access
TTS, sounds and soundboard with persisted queues
calls ported from Live (off until the calls cutover)
openvibe.chat site: global chat, messages, rooms, settings, history download
chat preferences in Network user modules
network blocks, revocation, account merge, export and deletion from Network events
outbox events and chat.room.message.* on the realtime plane
